tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind the panels and the range.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Recessed surfaces: fields, the practice range, the top bar, the Studio rail and status bar, and the track of segmented controls and tabs.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Sidebars and panels (Loadout, Session, Capture, Inspector) and the controls floating over the range: toolbar groups, the settings chip, icon buttons, the tool palette.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards inside panels: the selected weapon, stat tiles, weapon tiles, magazine tier options, Studio sections.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, chips, popovers, toasts, the consent card and the current item of the top navigation; also the rule between table rows.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fills, the current item of the Studio rail, neutral status badges, progress tracks, chart gridlines and the rule under table headers.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The Studio editing canvas around the wall screenshot.

tokens.name: wall
tokens.usage: Fill of the wall-screenshot frame on the Studio canvas while no image is loaded.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Separators, and the 1 px outline of chips, icon buttons, toolbar groups, segmented tracks and unselected tier options. Also the fill of the selected item in neutral segmented controls and Studio tabs; it stands only 1.4:1 off its inset track, so a 1 px field outline marks that item too.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and selects, and the 1 px outline of the selected item in neutral segmented controls and Studio tabs: 3.6:1 on inset, 3.5:1 on panel, 3.4:1 on card.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: 1 px outline of panels and the range, and the rules under the top bar, over the status bar and above the legal footer. Decorative (1.1:1 on panel), never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: outline-card
tokens.usage: 1 px outline of cards and tiles inside panels: stat tiles, weapon tiles, the selected weapon, Studio sections. Decorative (1.2:1 on card).

tokens.name: outline-strong
tokens.usage: 1 px outline of raised controls and overlays (secondary buttons, keyboard keys, toasts, the consent card, the Studio tag), dashed for empty states, and the dashed median line in trends.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and values: 17:1 on ground, 16:1 on panel, 15:1 on raised, 13.5:1 on hover. Also the tooltip fill, with ground as its text (17:1).

tokens.name: text-soft
tokens.usage: Running text in compact overlays such as the consent card: 11.1:1 on raised.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: field labels, meta lines, unselected segments and chips, links in the legal footer. 8.4:1 on panel, 7.9:1 on raised, 7.1:1 on hover.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Section and stat labels, captions, counts and placeholders: 5.6:1 on panel, 5.3:1 on card, 5.2:1 on raised, 4.7:1 on hover (its lowest).

tokens.name: icon-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled icons (Redo with nothing to redo) and the placeholder weapon icon. 3.1:1 on panel: disabled or decorative marks only, never text.

tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary buttons, the selected segment, the active tool, selection outlines, links, focus rings, the player's shots and good results. 15:1 on ground, 14.2:1 on panel, 13.3:1 on raised.

tokens.name: volt-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on volt fills: 15:1.

tokens.name: volt-bright
tokens.usage: Link hover: 15.8:1 on panel.

tokens.name: volt-wash
tokens.usage: Fill of selected chips, weapon tiles and tier options (with a volt outline), the positive status badge and the score delta pill. Over panel, text reads 12.1:1 on it and volt 10.7:1.

tokens.name: volt-wash-strong
tokens.usage: Disc behind the success icon in toasts.

tokens.name: volt-ink-wash
tokens.usage: Keyboard hint inside a volt button (Save spec, Ctrl S): volt-ink reads 11.2:1 on it.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Paths and targets on canvases, such as the start point in the Studio: 10.5:1 on panel, 11.1:1 on canvas.

tokens.name: pattern-ink
tokens.usage: The weapon's pattern drawn faintly on the range and in pattern views: its line at 16 to 22 % opacity, its dots at 35 to 60 %.

tokens.name: range-dot
tokens.usage: 1 px dot grid on the practice range (24 px pitch) and in the phone pattern view (18 px).

tokens.name: canvas-dot
tokens.usage: 1 px dot grid on the Studio canvas (20 px pitch).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Unsaved changes and anything that needs attention: 10.5:1 on panel, 8.4:1 on warning-wash.

tokens.name: warning-wash
tokens.usage: Fill of warning status badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: 6.0:1 on panel, 5.4:1 on danger-wash.

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: Fill of destructive buttons.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Outline of destructive buttons and danger notices: 3.2:1 on panel, 3.1:1 on raised and card.

tokens.name: tier-base
tokens.usage: Bar of the Base magazine tier, and of the single magazine of one-size weapons: 5.9:1 on card.

tokens.name: tier-1
tokens.usage: Bar of the Level 1 magazine tier: 14.7:1 on card.

tokens.name: tier-2
tokens.usage: Bar of the Level 2 magazine tier: 5.5:1 on card.

tokens.name: tier-3
tokens.usage: Bar of the Level 3 magazine tier: 5.4:1 on card.

tokens.name: tier-corrupted
tokens.usage: Bar of the Corrupted magazine tier: 5.4:1 on card.

tokens.name: chart-bar
tokens.usage: Bars counting tries in the score chart, and their legend swatch. 1.4:1 on panel, under the 3:1 asked of data marks, so the counts are also given as text (the tooltip, the totals); kept that way on purpose, as lighter bars would compete with the score lines.

tokens.name: panel-glass
tokens.usage: The run result card floating over the range: panel at 94 %.

styles.name: score-xl
styles.usage: The score on the run result card, in volt.

styles.name: score-lg
styles.usage: The last score in the session panel.

styles.name: summary-value
styles.usage: Totals on the Progress page.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Page titles.

styles.name: page-title-phone
styles.usage: Page titles on phones.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: Values in stat tiles; volt for an all-time best or a new best.

styles.name: weapon-name
styles.usage: The selected weapon's name (20 px on phones).

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Titles of Studio panels.

styles.name: score-cell
styles.usage: Scores in tables; volt from 85 up.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Section labels at the top of panels (Loadout, Session, Spec, Layers): uppercase, in text-muted.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Click and hold anywhere in the range to spray
styles.usage: The instruction in the range and other one-line leads.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Headings of cards and page sections.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Stored in this browser only. Clearing site data removes it.
styles.usage: Body text and control text; the Studio sets 13 px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Control and group labels (Magazine, Fire mode), weapon tile names, card titles.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Text in segmented controls, chips and status badges.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, field labels, meta lines and tips.

styles.name: stat-label
styles.usage: Labels of stat tiles: uppercase, in text-muted.

styles.name: legal
styles.sample: Based on apex-recoil by Mikhail Goncharov, Apache License 2.0.
styles.usage: The legal footer, the Studio status bar and chart axis labels.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Small uppercase tags such as the Studio tag.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Tier names under magazine capacities and labels in the Studio rail.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Magazine capacities in tier options and other readouts.

styles.name: field-number
styles.usage: Numbers typed into fields (13 px in the Studio).

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Inline values: zoom level, layer opacity, shot counters.

styles.name: key
styles.usage: Keyboard keys.

spacing.note: Core steps 4, 8, 12, 16, 24 and 32; the screens also use the in-between steps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between the items of segmented controls and the zoom control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of segmented controls, tabs and the zoom control.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Core step. Between top navigation items and tools, label to value in stat tiles, tool palette padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between chips, tier options, rail items, and a field label and its field.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Core step. Between buttons, toolbar groups and stat tiles.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its label, chip padding, Studio field padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Core step. Card padding, field and button padding, gaps inside cards.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Between blocks in a panel, button padding, the offset of floating range controls.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Core step. Panel padding and the gap between panels and the range.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Padding of large cards: Progress sections and the run result card.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Side padding of pages and the top bar.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Core step. Range dot-grid pitch, page top padding, gaps between page sections.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Core step. Bottom padding of pages.

tokens.name: radius-key-inset
tokens.usage: A keyboard hint inside a button.

tokens.name: radius-key
tokens.usage: Keyboard keys.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small: items of the neutral segmented control (fire mode).

tokens.name: radius-segment
tokens.usage: Items of segmented controls and tabs, zoom buttons, magazine-size inputs.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Controls 34 to 36 px high: icon buttons, top navigation items, Studio fields and buttons; tooltips; the logo square.

tokens.name: radius-control-lg
tokens.usage: Controls 38 px high: buttons, fields and selects; magazine tier options.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Tiles and stat tiles, toolbar groups, segmented tracks, the search trigger, 40 px link buttons.

tokens.name: radius-card-lg
tokens.usage: Cards inside panels (score card, selected weapon, Studio sections), toasts, the tool palette, the canvas frame.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels, the practice range, the run result card, the consent card.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Sections and bottom sheets on phones.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, status badges, the delta pill.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Cards floating over the range, such as the run result.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets on phones, such as the consent sheet.

tokens.name: size-badge
tokens.usage: Status badges (30 px in the Studio top bar).

tokens.name: size-segment-sm
tokens.usage: Items of the neutral segmented control (fire mode).

tokens.name: size-segment
tokens.usage: Items of segmented controls, filter chips, zoom buttons.

tokens.name: size-tab
tokens.usage: Studio tabs and magazine-size inputs.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and fields in the Studio.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Icon buttons and the language select in the top bar; tools in the tool palette.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields and selects; toolbar groups on the range.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: The search trigger, link buttons in panels, the main action of a Studio section.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Every control on phones.

tokens.name: size-tile
tokens.usage: Weapon tiles in the loadout grid (76 px without the RPM line).
